content: Yɛsu kàfàtɛn a ba naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, amwɛy uboo a baar bà pà, bàsàkwà anki kusà muman Imwol a Nzam kyàmuyiyà anà ngwal. »
Ngyoolà a Yɛsu
Ungö ilä isyaam, Yɛsu kàwɛl Petɔlà, Zyak anà Ywan, waa kasyen u mpey udu a mɔŋ a bwɛlàbwɛl. Nde kàyoolà ifà u mii a ba,
ipfɛy ande byàbulà byà tsɛk tsɛk, anà pɛɛl làmwɛy mpa kan'kwo akà un'yiir mwɛy mutwey.
Ɛli kàyàmɛnà anà Mɔsɛ akà ba. Ba bàkayäämà a Yɛsu.
Petɔlà kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, yubwaŋ naa bi ikäl apà. Wɛy bi imbaar ntɛn, ntɛn tär: mwɛy ntɔn ngye, mwɛy ntɔn Mɔsɛ, mwɛy ntɔn Ɛli. »
Nde kàyöb anki naa nde nkye utɛɛnà, ntɔn matɛɛr màkyer awal.
Un'böŋ mwey kàyafwee wa, ndaa mwɛy yàtoo uboo un'böŋ awà naa: « Awà wà Mwan amɛ wà nkween. Lun'wem! »
Ungö apan, bàler ba umbil aba, ba bàsàman anki akà mbuur mwɛy, Yɛsu mpɛl anà ba.
Umpal bàyàtyà ba u mɔŋ, nde katsüŋ mukyään itàkal akà mbuur mwɛy ndaa bàmɛn ba, tii mpal usàwiyà Mwan a mbuur uboo a akü.
Ba bàkyer akaar nswɛɛŋ ayi, wɛɛ ba bàfuulà ba a ba naa: « Ikaswaŋà aben "ngwiiyà uboo a akü"? »
Apan ba bun'fuul naa: « Ntɔn nkye alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàfàtɛn ba naa: "Ɛli akyer atwab atàyà"? »
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Yabwɛy naa Ɛli atàyà muyàfuur indiir byanswà u mbwo. Wɛɛ ntɔn nkye bàsön ba ntɔn Mwan a mbuur naa nde akyɛr aman mpay mbɔɔn, bun'wal asànaa undiir a bunàbun?
Wɛɛ mɛ alàkyään naa Ɛli kàkyàyà, baar bun'kyer ndaa yanswà bàkwen ba, asànaa bàsön ya ntɔn nde. »
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr mwan kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe
Mpal bàyafurà ba akà alɔŋki, ba bàmɛn un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn apà ba anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàmusyeelà mbaaŋ anà ba.
Pa kàmɛn wa Yɛsu, un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà laa kàbamà wa, waa kàkyeenà ntiin mukun'pà mbɔr.
Nde waa kafuul naa: « Ininà bɛ làsyeelà mbaaŋ anà ba? »
Baal mwɛy uboo a un'sɛŋ a baar kun'fuur naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, mɛ amatwääl mwan amɛ wàbaal: nde we anà dweelà a nkiin.
Ikal kyanswà lun'kaar la, la lun'bwiy u mɛɛn, mwan ugyɔrà an'te, laa ukwoor nde an'din ande, waa ubwà un'sey. Mɛ an'tɛn a alɔŋki angye naa ba bàböŋ la, wɛɛ ba bàsàkal anki anà ngwal. »
Nde waa utɛn a ba naa: « Nkööl ikɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà, tii nkye taaŋ mɛ insàkal anà bɛ? Tii mpal nà mɛ in'sàkaŋ mpem ntɔn bɛ? Lan'twääl awà. »
Ba waa bun'twääl. Umpal làmɛn dweelà a làbe Yɛsu, la làni mwan a ngwal, mwan kàbü u mɛɛn, waa kàyisilà wàmuyigyɔrà an'te.
Yɛsu kàfuul taarànde naa: « Sɛmà taaŋ nà ya ifun'yeel? » Nde waa kàten naa: « Sɛmà imbɛy ande.
Mbalà mbɔɔn la làfun'tɔɔm u mbaa anà kan'dà ntɔn mukun'dwa. Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ngye an'kwo mukyer undiir, yà ibay, ntɔn ngyɛb angye akà bi! »
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Isàkal naa ngye an'kwo! ... Indiir byanswà byàŋàkwo akà mbuur awe anà làkwikilà. »
Apan sye, taar a mwan kàsi un'kwɛŋ naa: « Mɛ an'sà làkwikilà! Mbay ntɔn an'kɔɔn mɛ làkwikilà! »
Yɛsu, abà kàmɛn nde un'sɛŋ a baar wàmuyàkɔ̈ŋ, nde kàswɛŋ dweelà a làbe, waa kàtɛn naa: « Dweelà a nkiin anà ikwan'tsü, mɛ amaswaŋ, too ubɔɔ a mwan wà, twon an'fyefurà! »
Dweelà làsi in'kwɛŋ, waa lun'ni a ngwal. Mwan kàbulà asànaa wàŋàkwà, lalan bàmbɔɔn bàteenà ba naa: « Nde kan'kwà. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'tɛ mpi u kɔɔ, kun'mbaar, nde waa kàmbarà.
Mpal kàfurà Yɛsu ndwà, alɔŋki ande bun'fuul ukɔl naa: « Wɛɛ bi, ntɔn nkye mpa ikwe bi muböŋ dweelà a làbe alanà? »
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Dweelà a tub alà làfàtoo u ngyamàkà mpɛl. »
Yɛsu kan'fàkyään nkweel anà ngwiiyà ande.
Ba bàlwomà apan, waa bàsoonà Ngalilɛ. Yɛsu kàkwen anki naa baar bàyɔ̈b.
Ntɔn nde kàlɔɔŋà alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: « Mwan a mbuur bàkyer ayun'yälà kàn'kɔɔ a baar, ba bàkyer ayun'dwà, waa ilä itär ungö a ndwääl ande, nde akyer ayàwiyà. »
Ba bàyöbà anki ndaa ayin, wɛɛ ba bàweemà bɔɔmà mukun'fuul.
Nà awà mbuur a kɔ̈làkɔ̈l?
Ba bàkyen Kapɛrnawum. Umpal kàkäl nde u ndwà, Yɛsu kàfuul alɔŋki ande naa: « Ininà bɛ làyisyeelà mbaaŋ u mbwo? »
Wɛɛ ba bàkäl akul, ntɔn u mbwo, ba bàyisyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba ntɔn muyöb naa nà awà mbuur a kölàköl.
Yɛsu kàkyer abwaay, waa kàbel Bàkwen Aŋiyweel, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukäl wàtàtwɛb, wɛy nde ukäl wàngöngö anà un'syääl a baar banswà. »
Apan nde kàwɛl mwan mwɛy, waa kun'si uboboo a ba. Ungö akun'böbà mpi, nde kàtɛn a ba naa:
« Mbuur awal mwan asànaa wà kikɔb amɛ, nde kan'wal mɛ ŋakwo: mbuur kàman'wal, kà mɛ anki nde kan'wal, wɛ Mbuur kan'töm. »
Mbuur mpa afàkyer bi ube wà anà bi
Ywan waa kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy wàmuböŋ an'dweelà an'be kikɔb angye, wɛɛ bi kàleŋ mukun'tsuŋ mukyer abun ntɔn nde bi kàfilabà anki. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Twon làmutsuŋ, ntɔn kà we anà mbuur anki kan'kwo mukyer impà kà ikɔb amɛ, waa ungö apan nde ufàtɛn ube ntɔn mɛ.
Abun, mbuur mpa afàtɔn bi wà anà bi.
Mbuur wanswà asàlapà kɔɔb a an'dà anwà, ntɔn bɛ làbà baar a Klistɔ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa, bweel ande làsàkyà anki bwà.
Igyɛɛŋ a ngwal
« Wɛɛ mbuur wanswà asiinà umwɛy uboo a bibaan ban'sà làkwikilà bà akà mɛ mubwà unsà ube, yan'söön ubwaŋ akà nde naa bun'bäm nkà a kölàköl u bway, waa bun'tɔɔm kà ɛwà.
Isàkal naa kɔɔ angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, tsul la. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà u mɔ̈ɔ̈ kɔɔ làmwɛy, akwànaa ngye mukal amà an'kɔɔ an'mɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa akyà yaaŋ a mbaa mpa làfàdim. [
Kwo, "in'swab myàfàkwà anki, mbaa ifàdim anki akà ikikye." ]
Isàkal naa làkɔl angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, tsul la. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà u mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà too, akwànaa ngye mukal amyà in'kɔl myeel, waa akyà yaaŋ a mbaa. [
Kwo, "in'swab myàfàkwà anki, mbaa ifàdim anki akà ikikye." ]
Isàkal naa dii angye làfasyen nkuur unsà ube, kwol la. Ntɔn yan'söön ubwaŋ naa ngye abilà imwol a Nzam anà dii làmwɛy, akwànaa ngye mukal amyà mii myeel, waa batɔɔm u yaaŋ a mbaa.

content.text: Kwo, in'swab myàfàkwà anki, mbaa ifàdim anki akà ikikye.

content: « Abun, mbuur wanswà asàlyaŋ u mbaa, asàwal muŋ ntɔn mupɔŋà.
« Muŋ wà undiir aŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ ntsà awa isàwà, bɛ ya làfuur aben? Làkäl anà muŋ uboo abɛ ŋakwo, làkäl unsà duu uboo amwɛy anà bumwɛy. »
